name: RackYield
tagline: Operating software for indoor growers who count every tray.
positioning: RackYield unifies rack scheduling, environmental logs, and harvest accounting so small vertical farms run like clockwork—one shared workspace per operator.

hero.h1: Run every grow rack like a balance sheet.
hero.sub: RackYield gives owner-operators one workspace for tray scheduling, climate logs, and yield-per-square-foot reporting—so your farm stops running on whiteboards and spreadsheets.

features.title: Rack-level scheduling
features.description: Assign crops, seed dates, and harvest windows to individual racks and tiers. RackYield flags gaps and overlaps before they cost you a full cycle.

features.title: Environmental audit trail
features.description: Log temperature, humidity, EC, and pH per zone with timestamped entries your buyers and auditors actually accept.

features.title: Yield accounting
features.description: Track grams harvested, waste, and revenue per square foot. See which cultivar earns its shelf space and which one doesn't.

features.title: Batch traceability
features.description: Every tray carries a lot code from seeding to sale. Trace a recall to the exact rack and day in under a minute.

features.title: Reorder alerts
features.description: Set par levels for seed, media, and nutrients. RackYield warns you before a stockout stalls the next plant-out.

features.title: Cycle forecasting
features.description: Project available trays and harvest dates weeks out, so you can promise volumes to wholesale buyers with confidence.

testimonials.quote: We used to reconcile harvest weights against a shared spreadsheet every Sunday night. Now every tray is logged at the rack. Our first accurate yield-per-square-foot report changed which crops we grow.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: The audit trail alone justified the seats. When our restaurant buyer asked for pH and EC history on a basil lot, I exported it in ninety seconds instead of scrolling through paper logs.
testimonials.name: Marcus Oyelaran

testimonials.quote: RackYield made our two-person team feel like a real operation. Scheduling racks and forecasting harvests in the same place means we finally stopped double-booking tiers.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
